meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
₹3000 ke andar **running shoes mil jaate hain**, lekin aapko *sale price* dekhna hoga kyunki kai recommended models MRP par is budget se upar hote hain aur discount me ₹2000–₹3000 ke beech aa jaate hain.[1][6][9][15]

Mere hisaab se aap in options ko pehle dekh sakte hain:

- **Nike Run Defy** — agar aapko **best overall** chahiye aur daily running + walking dono ke liye ek balanced shoe chahiye; ek source ne ise ₹2,796 par lightweight daily trainer bataya hai.[6]
- **Puma Voltaic Evo** — agar aapka focus **running performance** zyada hai, to ye ek strong pick ke roop me recommend kiya gaya hai.[10]
- **ASICS Patriot 13 / Jolt 5** — beginners ke liye kaafi popular entry-level options hain, aur under-₹3000 list me frequently mention hote hain.[1]
- **Adidas Duramo SL / Duramo SL 2** — daily training aur beginner runs ke liye commonly recommended budget options hain.[1]
- **Skechers Go Run Consistent / Go Run Elevate** — comfort-focused budget running shoes ke roop me mention hue hain.[1]
- **Campus DRIVO / Campus-type budget runners** — agar aapko **lowest-price** option chahiye aur mostly short runs ya gym use hai.[9]

Agar aap **sirf ek shoe** lena chahte hain, to simple rule ye rakho:

- **Best overall:** Nike Run Defy.[6][10]
- **Best for pure running:** Puma Voltaic Evo.[10]
- **Best beginner value:** ASICS Patriot 13 ya Adidas Duramo SL.[1]
- **Best ultra-budget:** Campus models.[9]

Kharidte waqt 4 cheezein check karo:

- **Cushioning**: daily 3–5 km runs ke liye enough hona chahiye.[1][2]
- **Weight**: lighter shoe beginner ke liye better hota hai; ek guide ne 281g jaise lightweight option ko advantage bataya.[6]
- **Fit**: toe box me thoda space ho, aur heel slip na ho.
- **Discount price**: under ₹3000 ke liye sale price important hai, MRP nahi.[1]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke liye **men/women**, **road running/gym use**, aur **your city/online store** ke hisaab se **top 3 exact picks** shortlist kar deta hoon.
